//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Cycle Paintings -> Config

Enable Cycle Paintings.//: Whether Cycle Paintings is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

ignorePaintingsInCycleResourceLocation.//: Split by a , (comma). The paintings to ignore during the cycle. You can either input an entire mod's prefix (only the part before the : (colon)) or the entire line found via 'showRegisteredPaintingsDebug'.

showRegisteredPaintingsDebug.//: When enabled, prints all paintings registered to the console. With this you can find which to add to the 'ignorePaintingsInCycleResourceLocationPrefix' config.
